title: Sephiria Root’s Retreat Guide — Hard Mode Stages & Unlock
description: Sephiria Root’s Retreat guide: what Root’s Retreat is (Hard Mode stage clears), how to unlock Hard Mode, the Stage 1 / 15 / 30 achievements, and what changes.
h1: Sephiria Root’s Retreat — Hard Mode Stages & Unlock
meta: For sephiria roots retreat / root's retreat searches.
body:
Root’s Retreat is the name Steam achievements give to Sephiria’s Hard Mode stages — it is not a separate village or DLC area. If you searched for sephiria roots retreat, you are almost certainly looking for how to unlock Hard Mode or how far its stage line goes.

What Root’s Retreat actually is

Clearing Hard Mode stages grants three Steam achievements named after the retreat:

  • Root’s Retreat — clear Hard Mode Stage 1
  • Root’s Retreat 15 — clear Stage 15
  • Root’s Retreat 30 — clear Stage 30

So “Root’s Retreat” is the Hard Mode stage ladder. Stage 30 is the long-term goal most community clears are built around.

How to unlock it (post Update 0.7.55)

  1. Finish Chapter 2 — story progress, not just any boss.
  2. Return to Bunnyville and talk to the Destiny tree.
  3. Open dialogue topics and select Hard Mode.

You do not need to buy a paid Destiny node on the normal path.

Legacy trap: older guides (and parts of the Steam “Basic Guide”) send you to a free node at the bottom of Destiny Inscription. TEAM HORAY moved the unlock to the tree dialogue in 0.7.55; treat Destiny-node instructions as outdated.

What changes in Hard Mode

  • Dungeons gain tougher modifiers / “elements” — community 1.0 writeups catalog 18 of them — so the same route plays very differently.
  • The talent budget expands once Hard Mode access is online; exact totals shift by patch, so verify in-client.
  • It is where players take proven builds after the story route — see Builds and the companion build.

Prepping for Stage 15 / 30

  • Spend Wishing Fountain picks before each attempt — pre-run Artifacts matter more when modifiers punish improvisation.
  • If the tree says unlocked but no entrance shows up, restart the hub — community threads report UI lag after unlocking (Hard Mode page).

Quick FAQ

Is Root’s Retreat a place in Bunnyville?
No — it is the achievement name for Hard Mode stage clears.

How many stages are there?
Achievements are documented up to Stage 30; anything beyond that is not yet documented.

Why don’t I see Hard Mode after Chapter 2?
Talk to the Destiny tree and pick the Hard Mode dialogue; if it says unlocked but the entrance is missing, restart the hub.
